name: grokbotfun
description: Deploy tokens on pump.fun straight from your agent: create a coin with metadata, image and socials, with an optional dev buy in the same transaction. Signs locally with your own wallet key.

pumpfunPrivateKey.title: Deploy wallet private key (base58)
pumpfunPrivateKey.description: Secret key of a DEDICATED hot wallet used to sign deploys. Fund it only with the SOL you intend to spend. Never use your main wallet.

solanaRpcUrl.title: Solana RPC URL
solanaRpcUrl.description: Optional custom RPC endpoint (Helius/QuickNode recommended for production launches).
